integrity: The codimension is the exact rank of the full matrix-unit evaluation map. Two independent exhaustive binary eliminations return rank 4487, and a separate lower-degree replay returns 1,2,6,23,90,340,1246 through degree 7. Finite computations are used only for this finite-dimensional rank; the field quantifier follows by multilinearity and scalar extension.
scientific_limitations: The result determines only the eighth ordinary multilinear codimension and does not solve the finite-basis problem or classify degree-eight generators. The full text of arXiv:2609.25362v1 was inaccessible in the inspected channel, so an unadvertised overlapping degree-eight computation remains a residual originality risk.
title: The eighth multilinear codimension of \(M_2\) in characteristic \(2\) is \(4487\)
